About Me

Analyst. Problem-solver.
Storyteller.

I'm a Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300) with a B.Sc. in Microbiology from Osun State University. My scientific background trained me to be precise, systematic, and evidence-driven — qualities I now apply to data analytics.

I've worked on real-world projects across international admissions compliance, environmental sustainability, election analytics, financial performance, and UN socio-economic data — building dashboards that drive actual decisions.

Currently based in Nigeria and open to remote and on-site roles in data analytics, business intelligence, and data-driven operations.
